## Purpose

Link every measured ion to the MetSigDB sets of OmniPath Metabo (KEGG,
Reactome and WikiPathways pathways, MACdb disease sets, ClassyFire chemical
classes), as input for the enrichment analysis (Phase 5).

## Inputs

- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/01_lines.rds` (ion table as published, Dataset EV2)
- OmniPath Metabo database, default deployment of `metabo.figures` (dev5), read only

## Methods

As decided after audit/12 (D30–D32): the MetSigDB sets are used as they are,
and only the feature side is extended. The original identifiers of each ion
(HMDB ID per candidate, normalised to seven digits; KEGG compound IDs) were
resolved to OmniPath Metabo entities, and each ion received the entities
equivalent to these at InChIKey level 2 (`config.yml: metsigdb`; same
connectivity and stereochemistry, so only charge variants are equivalent).
The ion's entities were looked up in the membership table by exact entity
match. KEGG IDs resolving to several compounds (classes) get no equivalents
and match only the sets that list that KEGG compound. Different compounds are
counted by InChIKey skeleton (level 1, D33), so that stereo or charge
variants of one candidate do not make an ion ambiguous. Records without a
structure (no InChIKey) that the database did not merge into the structure
entity are reached through the specific identifiers (HMDB, KEGG, ChEBI,
PubChem) of the ion's structure entities (D35). An
ion belongs to a set if any of its candidates does; for each link, the
number of the ion's structures in the set is kept, and each set reports how
many of its ions have a single structure (unambiguous ions). Pathway sets are
restricted to human; ClassyFire and MACdb sets have no organism. Levels 1
and 3 are shown for comparison.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# metabo.figures provides the database connection
pkgload::load_all(here::here(), export_all = FALSE, quiet = TRUE)
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/metsigdb.R"))
config <- load_config()
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "06_metsigdb_sets")

inputs <- c(lines = file.path(derived_dir, "01_lines.rds"))
ions <- readRDS(inputs[["lines"]])$ions %>% mutate(feature_id = paste0("V", ionIdx))
```

## Identifiers and links

```{r link}
ids <- ion_identifiers(ions)
count(ids, id_type)

con <- pg_connect()
db_build <- build_manifest_for(con)
level <- config$metsigdb$chemical_resolution_level
links <- link_ions_to_sets(con, ids, level = level)

# for comparison: the other two levels, and the chosen level without cross-references
by_level <- lapply(c(`1` = 1, `2` = 2, `3` = 3), function(l) if (l == level) links else link_ions_to_sets(con, ids, l))
by_level[["2 without cross-references"]] <- link_ions_to_sets(con, ids, level, cross_references = FALSE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
bind_rows(lapply(names(by_level), function(l) {
    x <- by_level[[l]]
    pathway <- x$ion_set$resource %in% c("KEGG", "Reactome", "WikiPathways")
    tibble(level = l,
           ions_in_pathway_sets = n_distinct(x$ion_set$ionIdx[pathway]),
           unambiguous_ions = sum(x$ion_structures$ion_structures == 1),
           ion_set_links = nrow(x$ion_set),
           generic_kegg_ids = length(x$generic_kegg))
}))
c(build_id = db_build$build_id, generic_kegg_ids = length(links$generic_kegg))

# links by route; the glutathione ion (V474) and WikiPathways' Glutathione metabolism (WP100)
count(links$ion_set, route, sort = TRUE)
links$ion_set %>% filter(ionIdx == 474, set_source_id %in% c("WP100", "hsa00480", "R-HSA-174403"))

ion_set <- links$ion_set %>%
    left_join(select(ions, ionIdx, feature_id), by = "ionIdx") %>%
    left_join(select(links$sets, resource, set_source_id, set_type, set_label), by = c("resource", "set_source_id")) %>%
    mutate(unambiguous = ion_structures == 1) %>%
    relocate(feature_id, ionIdx)
preview_table(ion_set, caption = "Ion-set links")
```

## Coverage

```{r coverage}
ion_set %>%
    group_by(resource) %>%
    summarise(ions = n_distinct(ionIdx), unambiguous_ions = n_distinct(ionIdx[unambiguous %in% TRUE]),
              sets = n_distinct(set_source_id), .groups = "drop")
c(ions = nrow(ions),
  in_any_pathway_set = n_distinct(ion_set$ionIdx[ion_set$resource %in% c("KEGG", "Reactome", "WikiPathways")]))
```

## Sets

```{r sets}
sets <- ion_set %>%
    group_by(resource, set_type, set_source_id, set_label) %>%
    summarise(ions = n_distinct(ionIdx), unambiguous_ions = n_distinct(ionIdx[unambiguous %in% TRUE]),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(select(links$sets, resource, set_source_id, set_size_db = set_size), by = c("resource", "set_source_id")) %>%
    mutate(share_unambiguous = round(unambiguous_ions / ions, 2))
sets %>% group_by(resource) %>%
    summarise(sets = n(), median_ions = median(ions), sets_with_5_or_more_ions = sum(ions >= 5), .groups = "drop")
preview_table(arrange(sets, resource, desc(ions)), caption = "Sets with linked ions")
```

```{r sets-plot, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4}
p <- sets %>%
    filter(ions >= 5) %>%
    ggplot(aes(ions, share_unambiguous)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
    facet_wrap(~resource, scales = "free_x") +
    scale_x_log10() +
    labs(x = "Ions in set (log scale)", y = "Share of unambiguous ions",
         title = "Size and ambiguity of the sets (sets with >= 5 ions)") +
    theme_uc()
save_figure(p, "sets", output_dir, width = 8, height = 4)
p
```

## Outputs

```{r save}
out <- c(ion_sets = file.path(derived_dir, "06_ion_sets.tsv"),
         sets = file.path(derived_dir, "06_sets.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(ion_set, out[["ion_sets"]])
readr::write_tsv(sets, out[["sets"]])
write_manifest(out, inputs, file.path(derived_dir, "06_manifest.json"),
               extra = list(omnipath_metabo_build = db_build$build_id, chemical_resolution_level = level))
```
